newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bankinter shares sag after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Bankinter shares sag after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in Spain's Bankinter lost ground on Tuesday after lacklustre first-half results, dealers and analysts said.
"The overall result was in line, but net interest income was disappointing," an analyst said.
First-half attributable profit rose 8.01 percent to 9.38 billion pesetas, against forecasts for a rise to 9.53 billion.
But net interest income, which reflects traditional loan and deposit business, slipped to 18.43 billion pesetas from 18.6 billion, despite a pick-up in the economy.
Analysts polled by Reuters had forecast on average net income of 18.83 billion. The actual figure was beneath both the average and the bottom of the range of forecasts.
At 1020 GMT shares in the group were trading down 630 pesetas, or 2.31 percent, to 27,400, while the Ibex index of 35 leading shares fell 1.04 percent to 7,094.71.
